title: Profiling-guided INT8 weight-only integration: streaming warm-start and regression harness
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Summary: Integrate profiling-driven INT8 weight-only (GPTQ/AWQ) profiles into the runtime calibration pipeline and add a deterministic regression harness that validates accuracy and numerical stability across host kernels and heterogeneous fleets. This ticket covers a new 'streaming warm-start' calibration mode to reduce per-request overhead, an integration shim for profile metadata, and automated nightly regression sweeps.

Background: Previous weight-only work focused on offline calibration with full-model snapshots. We observed a warmup latency spike and profile mismatches when swapping kernels on heterogeneous hosts. Profiling-guided warm-start aims to reuse collected activation statistics and avoid full re-calibration when model variant or sequence length distributions change slightly.

Scope and deliverables:
- Runtime API changes: accept 'profile_metadata' blob and 'warm_start=true' flag on deployment. (RPC/REST API contract documented in Confluence link)
- Calibration workflow: extend calibration service to support incremental prefix statistics merging and confidence-weighted quant table updates for GPTQ/AWQ.
- Regression harness: deterministic golden-answer regression runner that executes saved prompt sets, compares token-level logits and final-text diffs with configurable thresholds, and produces a nightly report + alert on regressions.
- Chaos tests: synthetic perturbation suite (temperature, seq-len, dtype switches, kernel-swap) to exercise fallback paths and ensure graceful degradation.

Acceptance criteria:
- End-to-end CI job passes for the integration PR: calibration service accepts profile_metadata and succeeds with warm_start=true in at least 3 model families (Llama2-13B, Mistral-7B, Falcon-40B).
- Nightly regression harness runs and has <0.5% golden-answer delta above baseline for standard prompt suite, or opens a bug if exceeded.
- New telemetry events emitted for 'calibration.warmstart.*' and 'profile.apply.*' and are visible in the quant-dashboard.
- Backwards compatibility: deployments without profile_metadata behave identical to current path.

Out of scope: FP8 experiments, on-prem installation instructions (handled in Private team), long-tail model family coverage.

test_plan: 1) Unit tests: profile metadata validation and fallback paths (local CI).
2) Integration tests: deploy warm-started model to staging and compare outputs against baseline (regression harness).
3) Nightly: run 10k prompt suite across 3 model families and aggregate golden answer deltas.
4) Chaos: run kernel-swap and sequence-length scaling scenarios with assertion on degradation.
notes: Decision: Use confidence-weighted blending of new stats with stored profile to avoid full recalibration on small distribution drift.
Trade-off: Warm-start reduces calibration time but may mask rare corner cases; harness intentionally runs full recalibration weekly as a safety net.
Follow-ups: If nightly detects >1% regressions for a model family, schedule a full retrain calibration job and open ENG ticket.
